$comment: Verified EmbeddedOS ecosystem model. Every field is sourced from the component's own repository, recorded in `evidence`. Nothing here is inferred from a name. Generated for the architecture explorer proposed in issue #52; see docs/ecosystem-graph.md for provenance and rules.
sourceOfTruth: each component's README on its default branch

components.name: EoS
components.purpose: Multi-platform embedded OS framework in C11: RTOS kernel, HAL with host and bare-metal backends, driver framework, networking, power and runtime services.
components.maturityEvidence: README: "The repository as a whole is Experimental." and "Nothing here has been observed to boot on hardware. No latency, throughput or power figure is published, because no reproducible benchmark exists to link to."
caveats: Networking is Planned: net/ is an API with a POSIX backend for host builds; eos_net_connect() returns -1 on bare metal.
RSA and ECC signature verification are stubs and refuse to run unless EOS_ALLOW_STUB_CRYPTO is defined. AES, SHA-256 and SHA-512 are implemented and pass NIST vectors.
84 board descriptors, of which 71 are named generic-* and none has been validated on hardware.

components.name: eBoot
components.purpose: Two-stage secure bootloader. Stage-0 performs early hardware bring-up; Stage-1 scans, selects, verifies and jumps to an application or RTOS image. Ed25519 image authentication, A/B slots, recovery and firmware-update transports.
components.maturityEvidence: README describes a working CMake project with unit, functional, fuzz, performance and simulation test suites; 83 board directories.
components.gettingStarted: cmake -S . -B build -DEBLDR_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build

components.name: eFirmware
components.purpose: Firmware image toolkit: build, sign-slot, inspect and verify the firmware containers eBoot loads.
components.maturityEvidence: README: "Status: early." Image container, SHA-256, CRC-32 and the efwtool host utility are Working; the update agent, transports and board bring-up are listed "Not started".
caveats: No site page exists for this component.

components.name: ebuild
components.purpose: Unified embedded build system in Python. A project is described in one build.yaml; ebuild resolves the dependency and toolchain graph and drives an underlying backend, then extends into firmware and system-image workflows.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents backend dispatch to CMake, Make, Meson, Cargo and Kbuild, or Ninja generation, plus a demo.md end-to-end walkthrough.
caveats: Unrelated to Gentoo's ebuild format; the README states this.

components.name: eIPC
components.purpose: Transport-agnostic inter-process communication library in Go. Exchanges messages as framed envelopes over pluggable transports and signs every frame for integrity.
components.maturityEvidence: README lists TCP, Unix socket, shared memory and Windows named-pipe transports, HMAC-SHA256 frame integrity, replay protection, a C SDK and unit/functional/integration/performance test suites.

components.name: eAI
components.purpose: On-device AI layer in C. Provides a runtime contract for loading and running models, plus EAI-Min (a lightweight agent runtime for IoT devices) and EAI-Framework (a larger platform for industrial systems).
components.maturityEvidence: README describes platform adapters, model-format loaders, optional accelerator backends and a BCI module; version 0.2.0.
components.gettingStarted: CMakePresets.json defines the presets used by CI

components.name: eNI
components.purpose: Neural-interface adapter in C. Acquires data from BCI hardware and simulators through a provider model, runs it through DSP, a neural decoder and an on-device inference engine, and drives a stimulator/feedback path.
components.maturityEvidence: README lists providers (eeg, lsl, neuralink, simulator, wireless), formats (EDF+, BDF+, XDF, native ENI), session management and calibration; version 0.3.0.
caveats: Channel count and sample rate depend on the acquisition hardware and configuration; unverified-claims.md C-003 retired universal platform limits.
components.gettingStarted: CMakePresets.json defines the presets used by CI

components.name: EoSim
components.purpose: Simulation and validation platform in Python, with a native simulation engine plus QEMU and Renode backends.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents a CLI (eosim list/info/run/test/doctor/stats/gui) and pip installation.
caveats: The README's own platform count (52+) differs from the site's simulated-platform figure; unverified-claims.md records that board and platform counts were previously conflated.

components.name: EoStudio
components.purpose: Python development and design platform: a visual editor and design suite with multi-target code generation, driven from a single CLI entry point.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents the click-based CLI, plugin system and ebuild integration.
components.gettingStarted: Open a project containing build.yaml; EoStudio drives ebuild

components.name: eDB
components.purpose: Embedded multi-model database. A Python engine built on SQLite exposes relational, document, key-value, graph and full-text-search interfaces behind one handle, as a library, a FastAPI HTTP API, or a React database-manager UI.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents the five engines, SQLite WAL journaling, FTS5, transactions via savepoints, JWT auth and RBAC.

components.name: eosllm
components.purpose: On-device LLM inference engine in portable ISO C99. Compiles to a single static library with a stable C ABI, plus CLI and server tools that run models entirely locally.
components.maturityEvidence: README: version 0.1.0, ABI 1; the CLI describes current generation as "Phase 1" — greedy text generation from a Llama/Qwen2-class GGUF model.

components.name: eBrowser
components.purpose: Privacy-oriented web browser in C11 for embedded targets and desktops. UI rendered with LVGL, TLS via mbedTLS; builds for EoS, SDL2 or WebAssembly.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents engine, render, network, input and security modules toggled through CMake options.
caveats: README scope note: "It is not a Chromium/WebKit/Servo replacement and does not aim for full web-platform parity."

components.name: eOffice
components.purpose: Open-source office suite as a TypeScript/React monorepo. One Vite web app hosts a launcher and eleven productivity apps, also shipping as PWA, Electron desktop and editor/browser extensions.
components.maturityEvidence: README lists the eleven apps under apps/ as a pnpm workspace.

components.name: eApps
components.purpose: Unified marketplace and monorepo for EoS applications across native, desktop, mobile, web, browser-extension, dev-tool, CLI and enterprise categories.
components.maturityEvidence: README documents the category table and a live GitHub Pages app store.
caveats: eOffice, EoStudio, EoSim and eBrowser were extracted to their own repositories; the README says so.

components.name: eCAD-Hardware-Products
components.purpose: Hardware and PCB CAD design collection organised by application domain, with datasheets, BOMs, power-budget scripts and some KiCad schematics.
components.maturityEvidence: README: "Status varies by design. Directories are at different maturity levels (many \"Design\" / \"Pre-production\"); PCB and CAD folders often contain .gitkeep placeholders rather than finished layouts."
caveats: 16 domain collections; completeness varies by design.
components.gettingStarted: Read each design's own README and docs/

components.name: eNet
components.purpose: Networking subsystem for EmbeddedOS: TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, MQTT, CoAP, discovery.
components.maturityEvidence: Repository description: "Planned; implementation currently in eos/net."

components.name: eSec
components.purpose: Security framework for EmbeddedOS: crypto abstraction, key management, device identity, attestation.
components.maturityEvidence: Repository description: "Planned; implementation currently in eos/services/security."

components.name: eFlow
components.purpose: Visual programming and dataflow authoring for EmbeddedOS, layered on EoStudio and ebuild.
caveats: The site page /eflow describes it in present tense; the repository says it is planned.

relationships.evidence: eBoot README: "providing verified boot for EoS and other payloads".
eFirmware README: "the firmware containers eBoot loads"; "156-byte container, byte-compatible with eBoot".
EoStudio README: "EoStudio is a front end for ebuild, the platform's build control plane — it drives ebuild rather than reimplementing what ebuild does."
eIPC README: "it provides the messaging layer between services".
EoS README: "EoS is the OS core of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem, alongside eBoot (secure bootloader), eAI (on-device AI), and eNI (neural interface)."
EoS README: same sentence as above.

profiles.name: eAI Edge
profiles.evidence: client/src/data/architecture.ts EAI_EDGE_PROFILE; the site page /eai-edge describes it as an in-development concept requiring validation.

notes: eos-stack-manifest and eFab are referenced by shared/stack-data.ts, client/src/data/stack.ts and scripts/sync-stack-data.mjs but both return HTTP 404, so `pnpm sync:stack` cannot run and the generated figures are not currently reproducible.
No component in this graph publishes a reproducible latency, throughput or power benchmark. Any performance figure on the website must therefore be phrased as a target, per docs/unverified-claims.md.
